svg.title: Private VNet and peering access with subscription keys or Entra ID through APIM Standard v2
svg.desc: Configured private access for users and systems in the same VNet or an authorized directly peered VNet. Private DNS resolves the normal APIM hostname to its inbound Gateway private endpoint. Choose the existing API-scoped subscription key or a separate Entra API with a validated gateway-audience access token and the assigned model role. Both choices reach the same three pinned Foundry deployments using APIM's managed identity and separate outbound integration. A private endpoint does not disable the public gateway; neither private routing nor an APIM subscription key bypasses Entra token and per-model role validation.

text.tspan: Intranet access | private APIM + isolated models
Users / systems in the same VNet or an authorized directly peered VNet; HTTPS 443 throughout.
Private reachability does not replace caller authorization
Choose a model key OR its separate Entra API + assigned role; private routing is not authorization.
Fourth subnet: snet-foundry-outbound / 10.42.1.0/24 is for supported agents, not this inference path.
Private DNS + routing are mandatory; peering alone does not propagate private DNS
Client: APIM_NAME.azure-api.net -> APIM PE private IP. Link/forward privatelink.azure-api.net for each client VNet.
APIM: normal Foundry FQDN -> Foundry PE IP via its private zones. Permit TCP 443 with approved NSGs/routes.
The public APIM gateway remains enabled. A private endpoint does not, by itself, restrict public access.
The three original APIs require a matching API-scoped key.
API policies validate the model and pin the backend.
The same key works over public or private ingress.
A bearer token alone does not authorize these key APIs.
Acquire an access token for the registered gateway API.
Validate tenant, audience, signature, expiry + model role.
No key is required here; a key cannot replace the token.
Separate key and Entra URLs authorize the same model; both reuse the private backend and APIM identity.
Both paths -> APIM system-assigned identity -> Foundry User (account scope)
Backend token audience: https://cognitiveservices.azure.com/ | Do not forward the caller's bearer token to Foundry.
Entra APIs: Subscription required = No; missing/invalid token -> 401; missing model role -> 403.
Routes above are API bases: append /chat/completions (POST, HTTPS 443).
Caller token audience: registered gateway API client ID, not Foundry. Assign only approved per-model roles.
Three key APIs + three Entra APIs; three shared Foundry deployments, not six models.
Entra access works through either public or private ingress; disabling public access is a separate network decision.
